examples.arabic: مساء الخير يا جدتي الإنترنت بالبيت بطيء كتير اليوم
examples.english: Good evening, grandma. The internet at home is very slow today.
examples.transliteration: Masāʾ al-khayr ya jaddati. Al-internet bil-bayt baṭīʾ ktīr il-yōm.

examples.arabic: حاولت شغل البروجيكتور بس النت كان كتير بطيء وما عم يشتغل ابدا
examples.english: I tried to turn on the projector but the internet was very slow and wasn't working at all
examples.transliteration: Hawalt shagghal el projector bas el net kan kteer batee' w ma am yeshteghil abadan
